data: This course complements COMP308 with some extended topics – type systems and alternative application semantics. Understanding type systems is crucial for many modern programming languages and the course will develop that understanding (similar to COMP308) through implementation of a range of type systems and proving their soundness. Students will also be introduced to goal search as a programming paradigm with the associated concepts of unification and backtracking, with an introduction to Prolog. Lazy evaluation and implementation strategies for it will also be dealt with. The course will continue to use (Typed) Racket as in COMP308.
